[tunneller] Tracked drill-rig with a front-mounted plasma-bore rotating and glowing white-hot, armored cab welded from orbital-debris panels and cargo-container flanks, reactor-core visible in the gut burning fel-green through hull gaps — three crew in cracked respirators and hide-harnesses: one on the drill-controls, one rewiring an alien-conduit power-pack, one on a rear-mounted arc-rifle watching the slag-wake.

[walker] Bipedal walker-rig with a barrel-torso welded from drop-pod fragments and locker-doors, hydraulic-piston legs ending in wide scrap-iron feet, glowing cyan energy-conduit veins running hip to shoulder — driver in an open-cage cockpit mid-yelling commands, gunner on the dorsal spine rope-tied to a swivel pulse-mortar, antenna forest of signal-rods and clan-banner poles rising from the crown, war-trophy chains dragging.

[wheeled] Six-wheeled scavenger buggy, Frankenstein chassis welded from two mismatched fusion-cells and a salvaged thermal-converter, exposed power-pack glowing amber behind the driver, ram-prong bristling with scrap-iron spikes — driver and rear-gunner in cracked goggles and war-paint, antenna spines whipping above with skull-trophies on every mast, sun-bleached faded paint barely visible through rolling rust-orange oxidation.
